1	// Program Buffer execution helpers for the RISC-V Debug Module.
2	//
3	// Follows the same duck-typed template pattern as dmi_poll.hpp so that
4	// resume_driver.hpp can include this header without a circular dependency.
5	// Bus type requirement: write(uint8_t reg, uint32_t val) and
6	//                       read(uint8_t reg) -> uint32_t.
7	//
8	// Debug Spec references: section 3.6 (Program Buffer), table 3.1 (DMI),
9	// section 3.7.1.3 (Abstract Command - Access Register).
10	
11	#pragma once
12	
13	#include "hybrid/abstract_command.hpp"
14	#include "hybrid/dmi_poll.hpp"
15	
16	#include <array>
17	#include <cstdint>
18	#include <span>
19	#include <stdexcept>
20	#include <string>
21	
22	namespace hybrid {
23	
24	// DMI address of the first Program Buffer register (progbuf0..progbuf15).
25	inline constexpr uint8_t kProgbuf0 = 0x20u;
26	
27	// Max payload instructions: 16 total slots minus 1 reserved for the
28	// mandatory ebreak that terminates execution.
29	inline constexpr std::size_t kProgbufMaxInsns = 15u;
30	
31	// Standard ebreak encoding (funct12=1, opcode=SYSTEM).
32	inline constexpr uint32_t kEbreak = 0x00100073u;
33	
34	// "Execute Program Buffer only" command (Debug Spec table 3.1):
35	//   cmdtype  = 0 (Access Register)
36	//   aarsize  = Bits64 (3) - ignored by DM when transfer=0, set for consistency
37	//   postexec = 1 (bit 18)
38	//   transfer = 0 (bit 17 NOT set) - skip register I/O, only run progbuf
39	//   write    = 0 (irrelevant when transfer=0)
40	//   regno    = 0 (irrelevant when transfer=0)
41	inline constexpr uint32_t kExecProgbufCmd =
42	    (uint32_t(AarSize::Bits64) & 0x7u) << 20 | (1u << 18);
43	
44	// Encode `vsetvl rd, rs1, rs2` (RVV 1.0 section 6.2, funct7=1000000).
45	// Tier-B restore: stage vl in rs1 and vtype in rs2 via Abstract Commands,
46	// then branch-free-restore both in one Program Buffer execution.
47	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_vsetvl(uint8_t rd, uint8_t rs1, uint8_t rs2)
48	{
49	    return (0b1000000u << 25)
50	         | ((uint32_t(rs2) & 0x1Fu) << 20)
51	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
52	         | (0b111u << 12)
53	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
54	         | 0x57u;  // OP-V opcode
55	}
56	
57	// Encode `csrrw rd, csr, rs1` (SYSTEM opcode, funct3=001).
58	// Tier-A PB fallback: stage the CSR value in rs1 via Abstract Command,
59	// then write it to a CSR that the DM cannot reach via abstract access.
60	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_csrrw(uint8_t rd, uint16_t csr, uint8_t rs1)
61	{
62	    return ((uint32_t(csr) & 0xFFFu) << 20)
63	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
64	         | (0b001u << 12)
65	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
66	         | 0x73u;  // SYSTEM opcode
67	}
68	
69	// Encode `vle8.v vd, (rs1)` - unit-stride vector load, EEW=8 (RVV 1.0 sec 7.4).
70	// Fields: vm=1 (unmasked, bit 25), width=000, mop=00, mew=0, nf=000,
71	// lumop=00000, opcode LOAD-FP=0x07. PB V-regfile reload sweeps v0..v31 from
72	// the shared scratch region after a vsetvl to e8/m1.
73	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_vle8_v(uint8_t vd, uint8_t rs1)
74	{
75	    return (1u << 25)
76	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
77	         | ((uint32_t(vd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
78	         | 0x07u;  // LOAD-FP opcode
79	}
80	
81	// Encode `vse8.v vs3, (rs1)` - unit-stride vector store, EEW=8. Mirror of
82	// encode_vle8_v with opcode STORE-FP=0x27. PB V-regfile dump sweeps v0..v31
83	// back to the shared scratch region at drain.
84	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_vse8_v(uint8_t vs3, uint8_t rs1)
85	{
86	    return (1u << 25)
87	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
88	         | ((uint32_t(vs3) & 0x1Fu) << 7)
89	         | 0x27u;  // STORE-FP opcode
90	}
91	
92	// Write insns[0..n-1] to progbuf0..n-1 and kEbreak to progbuf[n].
93	// Clears any sticky abstractcs.cmderr (W1C), issues kExecProgbufCmd, polls
94	// until abstractcs.busy clears, then verifies cmderr stayed clear.
95	//
96	// Throws std::runtime_error if insns.size() > kProgbufMaxInsns, if the poll
97	// times out, or if the DM raises cmderr during execution. No caller has a
98	// legitimate reason to silently continue on PB failure - the hart state
99	// would be partially restored / partially drained, which is worse than
100	// surfacing the fault.
101	template<typename Bus>
102	inline void exec_progbuf(Bus& bus, std::span<const uint32_t> insns)
103	{
104	    constexpr uint8_t  kAbstractcs   = 0x16u;
105	    constexpr uint8_t  kCommand      = 0x17u;
106	    constexpr uint32_t kBusy         = 1u << 12;
107	    constexpr uint32_t kCmderrMask   = 0x7u << 8;
108	
109	    if (insns.size() > kProgbufMaxInsns)
110	        throw std::runtime_error(
111	            "exec_progbuf: too many instructions ("
112	            + std::to_string(insns.size()) + " > "
113	            + std::to_string(kProgbufMaxInsns) + ")");
114	
115	    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < insns.size(); ++i)
116	        bus.write(static_cast<uint8_t>(kProgbuf0 + i), insns[i]);
117	    bus.write(static_cast<uint8_t>(kProgbuf0 + insns.size()), kEbreak);
118	
119	    if ((bus.read(kAbstractcs) & kCmderrMask) != 0u)
120	        bus.write(kAbstractcs, kCmderrMask);
121	
122	    bus.write(kCommand, kExecProgbufCmd);
123	    poll_until_clear(bus, kAbstractcs, kBusy, "exec_progbuf busy");
124	
125	    const uint32_t cmderr = bus.read(kAbstractcs) & kCmderrMask;
126	    if (cmderr != 0u)
127	        throw std::runtime_error(
128	            "exec_progbuf: PB execution raised cmderr="
129	            + std::to_string(cmderr >> 8));
130	}
131	
132	// vtype encoding for e8, m1, ta, ma (vsew=000, vlmul=000, vta=1, vma=1).
133	// The V-data sweep loads/stores one byte-element per lane (vl=vlenb).
134	inline constexpr uint32_t kVtypeE8M1 = 0xC0u;
135	
136	// Abstract-command write of a 64-bit value to Debug Module register `regno`
137	// (GPR/CSR/FPR): DATA0/DATA1 + Access-Register(write) + busy-poll. Free
138	// function so ResumeDriver, StateDrain, and the V-data sweep share one copy.
139	template<typename Bus>
140	inline void write_register_abstract(Bus& bus, uint16_t regno, uint64_t value)
141	{
142	    constexpr uint8_t  kData0      = 0x04u;
143	    constexpr uint8_t  kData1      = 0x05u;
144	    constexpr uint8_t  kAbstractcs = 0x16u;
145	    constexpr uint8_t  kCommand    = 0x17u;
146	    constexpr uint32_t kBusy       = 1u << 12;
147	    bus.write(kData0, static_cast<uint32_t>(value & 0xffffffffu));
148	    bus.write(kData1, static_cast<uint32_t>((value >> 32) & 0xffffffffu));
149	    bus.write(kCommand,
150	              access_register_command(regno, AarSize::Bits64, /*write=*/true));
151	    poll_until_clear(bus, kAbstractcs, kBusy, "write_register_abstract");
152	}
153	
154	// Sweep all 32 V data registers between the hart regfile and a contiguous
155	// scratch region via the Program Buffer. load=true issues vle8.v
156	// (scratch -> regfile, on resume); load=false issues vse8.v (regfile ->
157	// scratch, at drain). The leading vsetvl to e8/m1 sets vl=vlenb (one
158	// byte-element per lane) and forces vstart=0, so each unit-stride access
159	// covers the whole register even when the hart had vstart!=0. Uses x5/x6
160	// (vsetvl operands) and x7 (base pointer) as scratch. `stride` is the
161	// per-register byte spacing in the scratch region (the wire format reserves
162	// HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX per reg, independent of the runtime vlenb).
163	template<typename Bus>
164	inline void pb_v_data_sweep(Bus& bus, uint64_t scratch_gpa, uint64_t stride,
165	                            uint64_t vlenb, bool load)
166	{
167	    write_register_abstract(bus, regno_gpr(5), vlenb);       // AVL
168	    write_register_abstract(bus, regno_gpr(6), kVtypeE8M1);  // e8, m1, ta, ma
169	    const std::array<uint32_t, 1> pb_vsetvl = { encode_vsetvl(0, 5, 6) };
170	    exec_progbuf(bus, std::span<const uint32_t>{pb_vsetvl});
171	    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
172	        write_register_abstract(
173	            bus, regno_gpr(7), scratch_gpa + static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * stride);
174	        const std::array<uint32_t, 1> pb = {
175	            load ? encode_vle8_v(static_cast<uint8_t>(i), 7)
176	                 : encode_vse8_v(static_cast<uint8_t>(i), 7) };
177	        exec_progbuf(bus, std::span<const uint32_t>{pb});
178	    }
179	}
180	
181	}  // namespace hybrid
